summary: Correction round for the ticket-04 adaptation delivery. P2: every reviewer-identified install shape (sequenced manifest, sequenced bun add, positional bun add/install) still fails on Bun 1.4.2 peer resolution for the private file: dependencies; only a manifest change (overrides/resolutions) installs, which is not an invocation route, so no branch was applied and the residual is restated precisely. P3: the mock-anchor helper gained a non-string guard and lost an unreachable branch; targeted Bun+Node mock sample 41/41 each, typecheck:node exit 0, and both full suites were re-run on the corrected source (Bun 12 446/23/1 with the same single residual; Node 12 447/23/0). Report fixes: alias-asymmetry clause with an empirically alias-symmetric Node control, guest-side final-run hash listing, and receipt-file annotation.

receipt_annotation: retrieved/list/bun-list.json and node-list.json are run receipts of the first list label, not discovery data
retrieved/list/bun-list-vitest.json and node-list-vitest.json are the vitest list --json discovery output used by the inventory comparison

retrieved/cases/<case>/receipts/list-r2.json plus tmp/list-vitest.json are the usable second discovery attempt

deviations: First Bun and Node mock-sample runs exited 1: the four mock paths were expanded from a zsh variable without word splitting, so Vitest received one filter argument and matched no file. Re-issued with literal paths; the failed runs are retained.
The first two correction evidence tarballs missed their members (escaped glob passed literally by zsh); partial, final and v2 tarballs are all retained, with v2 used here.

The P2 probes ran in the SSH default environment (HOME=/Users/navide, no BUN_INSTALL_CACHE_DIR, no node/bun on PATH) with absolute case paths and --cache-dir; they wrote only under the case tmp/ and read no secret.
bun pm cache printed the global default /Users/navide/.bun/install/cache in that shell, a consequence of the probe environment; the installer under test passes --cache-dir explicitly.

The Node case's vitest.config.ts was switched to the branch config for the alias-symmetric control (base variant saved guest-side as vitest.config.base-variant.ts); only corr-* receipts, logs and tmp/correction-01 files were added, and no existing receipt or log was modified.
